description: PreviewEquityIntakeHydration says what the company's proof-of-company intake would carry onto an application, without writing. Read-only, and unavailable rather than an error when there is no intake to read.  It also reports whether the business was incorporated outside the US, which is the one answer that ends an application rather than blocking a step — so a caller can say so before collecting anything.
name: banking_preview_equity_intake_hydration
title: Preview Equity Intake Hydration
